completion.releaseNote: sati card approve signs off a file; the guard blocks changes to it until it is approved again.
completion.summary: sati card approve <file> stores the SHA-256 of the file's bytes on its card (approved: hash, by, at); --clear removes it (commit 784b69e). New guard rule approved-changed, always blocked: an intended edit is blocked whatever the bytes; a change already made passes when the file still has the approved hash. In a general project the guard now checks approved files only. card get shows approved / CHANGED / MISSING. doctor --fix never drops an approved card. No MCP tool approves, so an agent cannot approve its own change. General projects have no feature_check tool; the agent sees approved on the card from context_get. Limits: nothing watches a folder without git hooks; no board button (idea noted).

title: Protected deliverables in a general project: an approved file is protected by its hash
